keywords.def: the way of the Prophet ﷺ: his sayings, deeds and approvals
a report recording what he said, did or approved
the right to be obeyed and followed

questions.q: Explain two reasons why the Sunnah is important to Muslims.
questions.a: 1) It explains the Qur'an in practice, e.g. salah (16:44). 2) It has authority: obeying the Messenger is obeying Allah (4:80; 33:36). Each developed.

questions.q: A Companion did something in front of the Prophet ﷺ and he stayed silent. Which form?
In the portal response box, write a set-passage answer: 'Explain what Qur'an 33:36 teaches Muslims about the Sunnah.' Refer to the passage directly.
questions.a: Quotes or paraphrases 33:36; explains that the Messenger's decisions are binding; links to 4:80, 33:21; gives a practical example.

questions.q: Extend: sort ten statements (pupil PDF) into qawl, fi'l and taqrir.
questions.a: As in the answer key on the pupil PDF.

questions.q: Stretch: write the opening of a 12-mark answer to 'Muslims today need the Qur'an but do not need the Sunnah', giving the view of someone who agrees.
questions.a: Some argue the Qur'an is complete and preserved; Sunnah reports vary in strength. Then turn to the counter.

questions.q: What does 33:36 teach about the Sunnah?
options: Believers follow what Allah and His Messenger decide
Only the Qur'an must be followed
questions.a: A) Believers follow what Allah and His Messenger decide. 33:36 joins Allah and His Messenger: a clear decision of the Messenger is binding. The other options contradict the ayah.

questions.q: Which ayah calls the Prophet ﷺ an excellent example?
Think again: why do Muslims need the Sunnah?
questions.a: The Qur'an commands following him, and the Sunnah explains and applies the Qur'an.
